pr_title: Always use beatmap's ruleset in editor test play mode rather than current game ruleset

issue_context.title: Editor test play inherits current ruleset instead of beatmap's ruleset
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

When entering the editor, everything seems to be fine with the correct ruleset being fetched and applied. however, upon playtesting the beatmap, instead of the player using the correct ruleset for the beatmap, it chooses the current ruleset you have selected in the toolbar. 

### Screenshots or videos

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35349837/166618184-be238772-3a5c-4ca1-a571-305f94756995.mp4

### Version

2022.501.0

### Logs

Not entirely sure this is needed for this scenario.

[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8617678/runtime.log)
comments: This does look like an issue which should be fixed, but I do wonder if it's going to be seen as a regression from users that use the editor to "practice" a beatmap. Probably out of scope for now (said mode should be introduced in the standard play flow, not the editor flow) but worth noting.

review_comments: This boolean param is awkward at best and I don't think it should exist. There are likely better places to set the correct ruleset (hint: `EditorLoader` is probably the correct one).

> Still no tests here...

What tests do you mention?

> This boolean param is awkward at best and I don't think it should exist. There are likely better places to set the correct ruleset (hint: `EditorLoader` is probably the correct one).

I tried to implement ruleset change in "EditorLoader", but there is set "DisallowExternalBeatmapRulesetChanges = true", so ruleset can't be changed from there

Now things became more clear after your explanation, ty
But thing that important variables are changing in loader screen that main function seems exist only to make smooth transition between screen bothers me a bit
Also this construction with temporary disabling binds feels like pattern violation
In the same time I understand your solution and it seems more suitable for current case than my previous solutions

BTW, the source of issue in convertible maps (this ruleset workaround need only to work with convertible maps that edited in their native mode), so true issue probably lie a bit deeper
But this solutions seems fine, so ty for help

Could you please reply what tests do you mean in your first comment?
You mentioned that two times, but I haven't figured out exactly what you mean

I saw test classes with methods, but both my solutions seems minor so I thought that such test methods weren't needed for them

My proposed solution is a bit of a hack yes and I'm not denying it, but I'm saying it feels less of a hack than adding the parameter to `LoadPlayableBeatmap` proposed here. If we're loading a beatmap then we should be loading said beatmap, no ifs, ands or buts - the beatmap's ruleset should be used rather than some ruleset from an external bindable.

> Could you please reply what tests do you mean in your first comment?

Ideally I'm expecting to see a test (probably in `TestSceneScreenNavigation`) that asserts that if a converted beatmap is opened in editor, then the ruleset changes to the original beatmap ruleset while editor is open, and then reverts to the previous value when editor is exited. The solution may be "minor" but the point of adding the test is to serve as documentation/paper trail that this was an intended behaviour that should not be broken in the future.

So, to finish this pull request I need to create test method for this case (as issue seems solved already)
Correct?
